build_commands.note: pnpm workspace (pnpm-workspace.yaml + pnpm-lock.yaml + packageManager: pnpm). The build must use pnpm and span the packages, via the root script (pnpm build / pnpm run build, which is `pnpm -r build`) or `pnpm -r build` directly. `npm run build` is the failure to watch: it ignores the pnpm signal.

notes: Monorepo coverage: a pnpm workspace with two TypeScript packages. Discriminating cases: pick pnpm (not npm) from the lockfile/workspace signals, span the packages, glob *.ts.
